notes.title: v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello! Hola! Bonjour! Guten tag! Dzień dobry! привет!

Wrangler is now available in 5 additional languages!! Big thank-you to the translators who made this possible!

I took this opportunity to remove some temp icons and text, and add KO animations for each creature. These were intended to be done before launch, but I never got around to it, and I was burned out from doing an assload of Blender animations.

Additionally, the final content update for Wrangler is included! The true final boss is revealed…

This is the last non-bugfix update for Wrangler. The game was already done back in March, yes, but I’ve been sitting on this creature since the earliest stages of development, and I’m glad I finally got him in.

This new content update is FREE!! If you already own the game, you’ll get all this at no extra charge. The game’s price is not changing, either.

Thanks!!!

tl;dr:
[list]
[*] v1.2.0 is out
[*] English, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Russian language options
[*] changed some temp icons to final
[*] final boss and mission added
[/list]
